documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of The Bard Meeting To Be Held On November 3, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Deep Industries presented its corporate presentation for August 2026, detailing its position as an integrated onshore and offshore oil and gas service provider. The company reported strong financial performance for FY26 and Q1 FY27, highlighted by significant growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT alongside an expanding order book. Management outlined key growth vectors stemming from government schemes like Samudra Manthan and GOBARdhan, while highlighting its diverse business verticals ranging from natural gas compression to offshore services via Dolphin Offshore. Deep Industries reported a strong performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue rising 40% year-on-year to INR 278.92 crores and EBITDA growing 38.7% to INR 131.8 crores. Management highlighted robust demand driven by government policy shifts toward domestic E&P, energy security, and natural gas adoption.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are gunning for a PAT of almost INR 500 crores for FY28.
guidance.quote: No, on FY28, we are gunning for a PAT of almost INR 500 crores.

guidance.claim: Revenue from the production enhancement contract is expected to be almost INR 150-plus crores in FY28 from the single field.
guidance.quote: So, yes, in current financial year, production enhancement with incremental production would start contributing from second half of this current financial year. And for FY28, we are quite bullish on getting almost more than INR150 crores of revenue from this particular contract.

demand_outlook.claim: The oil and gas industry is transitioning towards structural rebalancing driven by various factors.
demand_outlook.quote: The oil & gas industry is transitioning towards structural rebalancing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that global oil demand is projected to rebound sharply through FY 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Driven primarily by Asian economy, global oil demand is projected to rebound sharply through FY 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that natural gas is firmly taking the role of a critical bridge fuel to achieve long-term energy security.
demand_outlook.quote: To achieve long-term security, natural gas is firmly taking -- as the critical bridge fuel.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported 100% fleet utilization in the onshore drilling rigs and workover segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Our fleet utilization is 100% in the segment as on date.

demand_outlook.claim: Management mentioned that the company's bidding pipeline continuously hovers around INR 700 crores to INR 800 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: And the bidding pipeline would be continuously hovering around INR700 crores to INR800 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: India is actively pursuing investments for its exploration and production sector as a part of a broader USD 500 billion opportunity in energy infrastructure by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: India is actively perusing investments for its exploration and production (E&P) sector as a part of broader USD 500 billion opportunity in its Energy Infrastructure by 2030.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated plans to do a capex of closely INR 150 crores by March 2027 for the production enhancement contract.
capex_expansion.quote: We also plan to do a capex of closely INR150 crores by March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: Based on broad estimates, the company may incur a capex of around INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: But yes, based on our broad estimates, we may do capex of around INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management estimates initial capex for reviving the Kandla manufacturing facilities at no more than INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, it would not be more than INR10 crores, INR15 crores as our initial estimate suggests.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for FY26 stood at 44.24%.
The company reported an EBITDA margin of 43.6% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Operational efficiencies have helped us post 38.7% Y-o-Y growth in EBITDA to INR131.8 crores in FY21 -- in Q1 FY27 with EBITDA margin of 43.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated they have been maintaining EBITDA margins in the range of 43% to 45%.
margins_costs.quote: We have been maintaining EBITDA margins in the range of 43% to 45%, providing us a decent cash flow to strategize our future growth trajectory.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing hydrocarbon fluids in-house from Kandla is expected to improve operating margins by 1.5%.
margins_costs.quote: So, our primary estimate suggests that we can improve on operating margin by 1.5% with the help of manufacturing this chemical in-house.

margins_costs.claim: Revenues in Q1 FY27 grew by 39.81% from Rs. 199.50 in Q1 FY26 to Rs. 278.92 in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Revenues in Q1FY 27 grew by 39.81% from Rs. 199.50 in Q1 FY 26 to Rs. 278.92 in Q1 FY 27

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA in Q1 FY27 grew by 38.73% from Rs. 95.02 in Q1 FY26 to Rs. 131.83 in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA in Q1 FY 27 grew by 38.73% from Rs. 95.02 in Q1 FY 26 to Rs. 131.83 in Q1 FY 27

margins_costs.claim: PAT in Q1 FY27 grew by 44.48% from Rs. 61.70 in Q1 FY26 to Rs. 89.14 in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: PAT in Q1FY 27 grew by 44.48% from Rs.61.70 in Q1 FY 26 to Rs. 89.14 in Q1 FY 27

margins_costs.claim: Cash PAT in Q1 FY27 grew by 45.23% from Rs. 78.08 in Q1 FY26 to Rs. 113.40 in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Cash PAT in Q1FY 27 grew by 45.23% from Rs.78.08 in Q1 FY 26 to Rs. 113.40 in Q1 FY 27

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns more than 80 gas compressors.
orders_capacity.quote: Asset size: the Company owns more than 80 gas compressors

orders_capacity.claim: As on June 30, 2026, the company's order book stood at INR 3,047 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: As on June 30, our order book stood at INR3,047 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns more than 80 gas compressor units, representing the highest fleet in India.
orders_capacity.quote: We own more than 80 gas compressor units, which is highest fleet in India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns a total of 20 onshore drilling rigs and workover rigs.
orders_capacity.quote: We own total 20 numbers of onshore drilling rigs and workover rigs, of which 14 are workover rigs, the capacity ranging from 30 to 150 tons, and 6 drilling rigs with capacity of 1,000 horsepower.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that capital expenditure is strictly committed only upon securing firm deployment contracts.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital expenditure is strictly committed only upon securing firm deployment contracts.

capital_allocation.claim: From the loan given to Prabha Energy, the company has received back almost INR 86 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes. So, from the loan given to Prabha Energy, we have received back almost INR86 crores from them.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that actual results could materially differ from forward-looking statements due to various risks and uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: This presentation contains certain forward-looking statements concerning the Company's future business prospects and business profitability, which are subject to a number of risks and uncertainties and the actual results could materially differ from those in such forward-looking statements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that due to an unfortunate incident at Mori 5, incremental production was delayed by 5 to 6 months.
risks_headwinds.quote: We had taken over the field in April 2025 and started with the baseline production. But due to an unfortunate incident at one of our wells at Mori 5, the incremental production was delayed by 5 to 6 months.

risks_headwinds.claim: A blast at the GAIL site increased scrutiny on the processes followed by producers and transporters of gas and resulted in regulations being made more stringent.
risks_headwinds.quote: Blast at the GAIL site increased scrutiny on the processes followed by the producers and transporters of Gas and resulted in regulations being made more stringent

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to start contributing through incremental production from the PEC contract by October 2026.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to start contributing through incremental production by October 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to do a capex of closely INR 150 crores by March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: We also plan to do a capex of closely INR150 crores by March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to clear the entire loan repayment from Prabha Energy by the end of the second quarter.
management_commitments.quote: And probably by end of second quarter, we are expecting to clear the entire loan repaid.

management_commitments.claim: The Company has secured a INR 1402 crore contract from ONGC for 15 years to offer comprehensive services to boost production from one of the Matured Fields of ONGC.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has secured a INR 1402 crore contract from ONGC for 15 years. The said contract offers comprehensive services to boost production from one of the Matured Fields of ONGC.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
